description: A buffered multiple in two banks of three, where the lower bank takes the upper bank's signal until it is given one of its own

inputs.text: The signal copied to OUTPUT 1, OUTPUT 2 and OUTPUT 3, and to all six outputs while INPUT 2 is empty
The signal copied to OUTPUT 4, OUTPUT 5 and OUTPUT 6; while this jack is empty those three carry INPUT 1 instead

outputs.text: A copy of INPUT 2, or of INPUT 1 while INPUT 2 is empty

notes: nothing is added to the signal: the voltages are copied straight across with no gain, offset or attenuation
the copy is polyphonic, and an output carries as many channels as the input feeding it
the jacks are not specific to any one signal; audio, pitch, gates and slow control voltages all pass through alike
